title: Dynamic page-step for session-list PgUp/PgDn navigation
source: exploration plan §10 – use actual rendered page geometry instead of fixed step constants
why_chosen: Highest-confidence bounded bug fix: replaced hardcoded SESSION_PAGE_STEP_COUNT=3 with viewport-derived step so PgUp/PgDn covers a full screen of sessions.
before: SESSION_PAGE_STEP_COUNT was always 3, so PgUp/PgDn moved exactly 3 items regardless of how many were visible (10-30+ on a large terminal).
after: Page step is computed from list_visible_rows (stored during render) divided by DEFAULT_ITEM_HEIGHT_ESTIMATE (5), clamped to [SESSION_PAGE_MIN_STEP(3), visible_rows]. PgUp/PgDn now covers roughly one screenful.
evidence: All 95 existing session_picker tests pass. Compilation succeeds. No new warnings.
